configuration.properties.bitfroest.colum: Active custom column set. The ID must exist in the configured column sets.

Up to 29 custom column views in addition to the standard view. Configure order, fields, alignment and visibility. Headings are derived from the fields. Widths adapt automatically. Unavailable fields are identified.

[=file.size.auto] displays automatic B/KB/MB/GB/TB/PB/EB units (1024-based); [=file.size] preserves raw bytes. Field template with literal text, for example [=file.name], [=file.size.kbytes], [=file.writedate.YMD], substring [=file.fullname:4-7] or conditional text [="("file.ext")"]. Date/time tokens: Y y M D h m s a P p. Content plugins require a matching provider.

columns.option.id: Stable, unique identifier of the column set. Used by the active set setting.
columns.option.name: Display name of the column set. Custom names are not translated.
columns.option.columns: Columns in display order with field templates, alignment and visibility. Headings follow the fields. Widths adapt automatically.
columns.option.column.id: Stable, unique identifier within this column set.
columns.option.column.visible: Show this column in the file list. Hidden columns remain in the configuration.
columns.legacy.description: Legacy JSON column sets. Used only while none of the new column tables or the order list is explicitly configured. Configuring a table switches to the table configuration; legacy values remain saved.
columns.tables.names.description: Column sets as an editable table: key = set ID (letters, digits, underscores or hyphens), value = display name. Example: `reports` → `Reports`. Up to 29 custom views plus `standard`. Add matching entries in **Columns: Fields**. Custom names are not translated. Editing any new table activates the table configuration in place of legacy JSON sets.
columns.tables.fields.description: Column contents as an editable table: key = `set.column`, value = field template. Example: `reports.file` → `[=file.fullname]`. The set must exist in **Columns: Names**. Removing an entry removes the column. `[=file.size.auto]` selects size units; `[=file.writedate.YMD]` formats a date. Unknown providers remain marked as unavailable.
columns.tables.order.description: Editable list of `set.column` keys in column display order. Unlisted columns follow in field-table order. Unknown and duplicate keys are ignored. Set order follows **Columns: Names**.
columns.tables.alignments.description: Column alignment as an editable table: key = `set.column`, value = left, right or center. Unspecified columns are left-aligned.
columns.tables.visibility.description: Column visibility as an editable table: key = `set.column`, value = show or hide. Hidden columns remain configured. Unspecified columns are visible.

colors.title: File colors
colors.fileTypes: Color file names and clean file metadata by file type. Colors adapt automatically to the theme background.

colors.rules: File name patterns (* and ?) and colors as #RGB or #RRGGBB. Longer patterns take precedence; ties use lexical order. Colors are adjusted for contrast.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.bindings: Local keyboard shortcuts by stable binding identifier. Separate alternatives with |; an empty string disables a binding. Missing identifiers use the inherited binding or the default. Use Configure Keyboard Shortcuts for key capture and conflict detection.
files.useSystemContextMenu.description: Use system context menu. When enabled, Windows file lists use the system menu. Otherwise, use the file manager menu with Copy, Cut, Paste and folder lock inspection.
